name: cli-session-buffer
body: The pending change set of a live session: the cumulative in-memory node-file writes and deletes accepted since the previous save. It is the source of a node's current content when the session changed that node earlier in the run, and the live database is the source otherwise; together they hold every field a node file carries. A save makes the buffer durable and empties it; an abort discards it. A mutation is built against the cumulative buffer, so a later change composes over every earlier pending change.
